"""Same-owner inherited lease validation; never acquires a new flock."""
import os,stat
from pathlib import Path

def birth(pid):
 raw=Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text();tail=raw[raw.rfind(')')+2:].split()
 return dict(pid=pid,start_ticks=int(tail[19]),boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip())
def flock_line(pid,fd):
 lines=Path(f'/proc/{pid}/fdinfo/{fd}').read_text().splitlines()
 locks=[x.split('lock:',1)[1].strip() for x in lines if x.startswith('lock:') and ' FLOCK ' in x and ' WRITE ' in x]
 if len(locks)!=1:raise ValueError('inherited exclusive flock evidence missing')
 return locks[0]
def inherited(parent,leases):
 if os.getppid()!=parent['pid'] or birth(parent['pid'])!=parent:raise ValueError('exact live parent changed')
 result={}
 for name,descriptor in leases.items():
  path=Path(descriptor['path']);s=path.lstat()
  if not stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) or (s.st_dev,s.st_ino)!=tuple(descriptor['identity']):raise ValueError('canonical lease named identity changed')
  matches=[]
  for p in Path('/proc/self/fd').iterdir():
   try:
    t=os.fstat(int(p.name))
    if (t.st_dev,t.st_ino)==(s.st_dev,s.st_ino):matches.append(int(p.name))
   except OSError:pass
  if not matches:raise ValueError('exact inherited lease descriptor missing')
  expected=flock_line(parent['pid'],descriptor['parent_fd'])
  # The worker intentionally duplicates the GPU OFD for its closeable lock seam.
  # Every alias must prove the same locked OFD; reopened descriptors still fail.
  if any(flock_line(os.getpid(),fd)!=expected for fd in matches):raise ValueError('not the parent locked open file description')
  result[name]=matches[0]
 if os.getppid()!=parent['pid'] or birth(parent['pid'])!=parent:raise ValueError('parent changed during validation')
 for descriptor in leases.values():
  current=Path(descriptor['path']).lstat()
  if not stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode) or (current.st_dev,current.st_ino)!=tuple(descriptor['identity']):raise ValueError('canonical lease changed after validation')
 return result


CANONICAL_LEASES={'gpu':('/home/<user>/projects/chess/scratchpad/gpu0_experiment.lock',(2096,81348917)),
                 'io':('/tmp/chess-physical-heavy-io-exclusive.lock',(2096,18503149)),
                 'supervisor':('/home/<user>/chess-artifacts/operations/deepfin-ceres-reserve38-recovery-queue-20261004-v5/supervisor.lock',(2096,18835410))}

def canonical_profile(profile='all_three'):
 """Closed custody profiles; choosing one grants no execution authority."""
 if profile=='all_three':names=('gpu','io','supervisor')
 elif profile=='model_only_gpu_supervisor':names=('gpu','supervisor')
 else:raise ValueError('unknown canonical custody profile')
 return {name:CANONICAL_LEASES[name] for name in names}

def canonical_gpu_lock_consumer(worker,parent,leases,custody_profile='all_three'):
 """Bind the reviewed worker lock seam to its owner's existing GPU OFD.
 The caller must bind an explicit custody profile in its reviewed request before
 using the model-only profile. This API does not acquire/release I/O or authorize
 payload scans. The all-three default retains its original contract.
 """
 fixed=canonical_profile(custody_profile)
 if set(leases)!=set(fixed):raise ValueError('exact canonical custody profile required')
 for name,(path,identity) in fixed.items():
  if leases[name]['path']!=path or tuple(leases[name]['identity'])!=identity:raise ValueError('canonical identity override forbidden')
 def lock():
  if custody_profile=='model_only_gpu_supervisor':
   io_identity=CANONICAL_LEASES['io'][1]
   for descriptor in Path('/proc/self/fd').iterdir():
    try:info=os.fstat(int(descriptor.name))
    except OSError:continue
    if (info.st_dev,info.st_ino)==io_identity:raise ValueError('model-only consumer must not inherit canonical I/O descriptor')
  validated=inherited(parent,leases)
  return os.dup(validated['gpu'])
 return lock
